title: Are courts precluded from granting fair, just compensation in nuclear accident: SC asks Centre
topic: Indian Supreme Court Inquiry on Nuclear Accident Compensation
summary: The Supreme Court of India has asked the Centre if courts are precluded from granting fair and just compensation in the event of a nuclear accident.
The inquiry aims to determine the extent of the judiciary's role in providing compensation for such incidents.

title: SC to look into plea to distinguish between criticism of judiciary and online distortion of what judges actually say in court
summary: The Supreme Court will examine a plea to differentiate between criticism of the judiciary and online misrepresentation of judges' statements
The move aims to address concerns about the spread of misinformation and its potential impact on the judiciary's reputation
